message:
Review of the draft almanac, before saving. Proposed file name: almanac-2026-11-22-v1.md (first compile, version 1). The full text is in testing/runs/rebuild5--S1-first-compile--r2/work/almanac-2026-11-22-v1.md

Sources: 16 files processed, 0 excluded (15 documents and 1 recording transcribed). The folder had no previous almanac, so this is a first compile. Changelog: none to compare.

Rule by topic, with the quotation that supports it:

1. Monthly fee and budget: $240 per unit from 2026-03-01. "the monthly common charge is set at $240 per unit, effective March 1, 2026." (minutes-2026-01-20.pdf, 3-0). Replaces $225 (2025-03-01), which replaced $210 (2024-03-01). The $230 notice of 2025-02-10 is corrected by the minutes of 2025-04-15: "the notice of February 10, 2025 stating $230 was in error." The $235 proposal was amended and not adopted.

2. Pets: maximum two per unit; registration required; no dog weight limit, from 2025-04-15. "each unit may keep a maximum of two (2) pets; the 35-pound limit for dogs is removed..." (minutes-2025-04-15.docx, 3-0). Replaces one pet and a 35 lb dog limit (2019 bylaws).

3. Renovations and work hours: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. from 2024-07-15; no Sundays or holidays. "amend House Rule 5 to permit renovation work on Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., effective July 15, 2024." (minutes-2024-06-12.docx, 3-0). Replaces no Saturday work (2019).

4. Balconies and exterior fixtures: heat pumps permitted with written approval if floor-mounted, not on the railing, at most 60 dB(A), from 2025-01-23 (vote 2-1). "heat pump outdoor units are permitted on balconies with written board approval, provided they are floor-mounted and not attached to the railing..." (minutes-2025-01-23.pdf). General fixtures still need written approval: "No fixtures, appliances or equipment may be mounted on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval." Barbecues and open flames are prohibited: "Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies." (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf, 2019-05-01). Provisional only: the 2026-06-18 recording, "So we all lean towards allowing electric barbecues. Let's not vote tonight." No vote was taken, so the prohibition stands.

5. Quiet hours: 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night, since 2019-05-01. "Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night." (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf). No change in any later document.

6. Rentals and leasing: minimum lease term thirty (30) days from 2025-04-15 (2-1). "amend House Rule 8 so that the minimum lease term is thirty (30) days. Effective immediately. Motion carried 2-1." Replaces six months (2019). A motion for leases of seven days or more failed 1-2 and changed nothing.

7. Parking: guest vehicles up to 48 hours from 2025-10-01 (3-0). "amend House Rule 9 so that guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 48 hours. Effective October 1, 2025." Replaces 72 hours. One assigned space per unit (2019): "Each unit has one assigned space."

8. Electric vehicle charging: allowed in the assigned space with written board approval, licensed electrician, owner's cost, from 2026-01-20 (3-0). "owners may install an electric vehicle charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval..." (minutes-2026-01-20.pdf).

9. Pool and amenities: CONFLICT for the 2026 season. Minutes of 2025-09-10: "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily. Motion carried 3-0." The notice of 2026-05-01 says: "Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily." A notice cannot replace an adopted resolution, so the conflict is recorded and not resolved. Standing 2019 hours (9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., June 1 to September 15) apply to other seasons.

10. Vendor contracts: INCOMPLETE. Landscaping agreement with Bramblewick Grounds LLC, term 2024-04-01 to 2026-03-31, $1,450 per month, auto-renews unless written notice is given at least 60 days before term end. "renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the current term." The minutes of 2025-09-10 set a notice deadline of 2026-01-30. The notice is dated 2026-02-02, after that deadline. The documents do not establish whether the agreement ended, renewed or continued, so the outcome is recorded as not established.

11. Officers and elections: board of three (President, Treasurer, Secretary), quorum two. The Treasurer resigned, and a new Treasurer was appointed until the next annual meeting, by 3-0 vote on 2025-09-10. The appointee is not named here. The next annual meeting date is not stated in the documents.

12. Governance and amendments: Part A (bylaws) changes need a two-thirds vote of owners at an annual meeting. Part B (house rules) changes need a majority vote of the board. "These Bylaws (Part A) may be amended only by a two-thirds (2/3) vote of unit owners at an annual meeting." (2019). The Skill does not rule on whether any vote met these thresholds.

Provisional items (4), from the recording of 2026-06-18 only: the electric barbecue discussion; the planned motion for the September agenda; the action for the Secretary to ask the insurer by the end of July; and the deferred objection to the pool notice hours (9 p.m. or 10 p.m.).

Open conflicts (1): pool hours, 2026 season (above).

Exclusions: none.

Open items: the Secretary's non-renewal notice was sent 2026-02-02, after its 2026-01-30 due date. The balcony engineer's opinion was received 2025-01-15. The renovation hours notice is dated 2024-07-01. Other open items are listed in section 4 of the draft.

Please approve saving almanac-2026-11-22-v1.md, or tell me which rule is wrong and which passage was misread. If you decline, nothing is saved.
